item.title: Tailscale Traces Database Corruption to 16y/o SQLite WAL-Reset Bug
item.description:
📝 Now we’re in summer, we’re confident that we’ve found the bug, that we understand it—and more importantly, that we’ve fixed it. Each shard has an SQLite database that holds all the information about the tailnets on that shard. This was painful for tailnets on that shard, because their entire control plane disappeared during that recovery window.
🔗 Read more: https://tailscale.com/blog/sqlite-wal-reset-bug

item.title: uBlock Origin Is Giving Up the Fight to Keep Ads Off Facebook
The Ultimate Horse
item.description:
📝 Between 43 and 33 million years ago, Mesohippus still sported three toes of roughly equal size, with each touching the ground. Hyracotherium, the progenitor of the horse family, appears in the fossil record in North America from around 55 million years ago, disappearing again 8 million years later. Around 12 million years ago, Hipparion, which, though three-toed, otherwise resembled modern horses, colonized Eurasia.
🔗 Read more: https://worksinprogress.co/issue/the-ultimate-horse/

item.title: Hax – a minimalist, terminal-native coding agent written in C
item.description:
📝 Does not take over or mess with your terminal. With Homebrew (macOS or Linux): brew install oleksandrchekhovskyi/hax/hax On Linux, download the prebuilt static binary for your architecture (x86_64 or aarch64) from the latest release, then unpack the hax binary into any directory on your PATH. Building from source gives a binary linked against your system's shared libraries instead of a static one: git clone https://github.
🔗 Read more: https://usehax.dev/
